missing_value_policy: Missing, invalid, inapplicable, and noncomputable values remain unavailable, never become zero, never enter robust-domain calculation, and render with the neutral No Data / Unavailable treatment.

metrics.definition: Percentile position of the accepted customer-fit public-data proxy among computable Michigan tracts.
metrics.source_label: Accepted MODEL-13 Michigan public-data proxy output
metrics.availability_policy: Available only when the accepted MODEL-13 tract output is computable.
metrics.warning_policy: Show model noncomputability and relevant support-truncation context.

metrics.definition: Accepted raw five-mile B11001 household opportunity mass around the tract's public internal-point anchor.
metrics.availability_policy: Use only valid accepted household-opportunity values; no missing-to-zero conversion.
metrics.warning_policy: Show five-mile support-truncation context when applicable.

metrics.definition: Percentile position of the accepted modeled target-mass output among computable Michigan tracts.
metrics.source_label: Accepted MODEL-13 Michigan modeled target-mass output
metrics.availability_policy: Available only when the accepted MODEL-13 tract output is computable.
metrics.warning_policy: Show model noncomputability and relevant support-truncation context.

metrics.definition: Median household income in the past 12 months for households in the tract; not Average Household Income or Area Median Income.
metrics.source_label: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020-2024 ACS 5-Year Detailed Tables
metrics.availability_policy: Use only DATA-04 rows whose accepted measure status is valid.
metrics.warning_policy: Show DATA-04 status, status detail, and margin of error.

metrics.definition: Aggregate income in the past 12 months divided by the tract population.
metrics.source_label: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020-2024 ACS 5-Year Detailed Tables
metrics.availability_policy: Use only DATA-04 rows whose accepted measure status is valid.
metrics.warning_policy: Show DATA-04 status, status detail, and margin of error.

metrics.definition: Civilian labor force as a share of the population age 16 years and over.
metrics.source_label: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020-2024 ACS 5-Year Detailed Tables
metrics.availability_policy: Use only DATA-04 rows whose accepted measure status is valid.
metrics.warning_policy: Show DATA-04 status, status detail, and margin of error.

metrics.definition: Employed civilians divided by the civilian labor force; not an employment-to-population rate.
metrics.source_label: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020-2024 ACS 5-Year Detailed Tables
metrics.availability_policy: Use only DATA-04 rows whose accepted measure status is valid.
metrics.warning_policy: Show DATA-04 status, status detail, and margin of error.

metrics.definition: People age 25 years and over with a bachelor's, master's, professional, or doctoral degree as a share of the age-25-plus population.
metrics.source_label: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020-2024 ACS 5-Year Detailed Tables
metrics.availability_policy: Use only DATA-04 rows whose accepted measure status is valid.
metrics.warning_policy: Show DATA-04 status, status detail, and margin of error.

metrics.definition: Owner-occupied housing units as a share of all occupied housing units; higher or lower values are not inherently favorable.
metrics.source_label: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020-2024 ACS 5-Year Detailed Tables
metrics.availability_policy: Use only DATA-04 rows whose accepted measure status is valid.
metrics.warning_policy: Show DATA-04 status, status detail, and margin of error.

metrics.definition: Vacant housing units as a share of all housing units; it does not by itself imply market strength or weakness.
metrics.source_label: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020-2024 ACS 5-Year Detailed Tables
metrics.availability_policy: Use only DATA-04 rows whose accepted measure status is valid.
metrics.warning_policy: Show DATA-04 status, status detail, and margin of error.

metrics.definition: Median value of owner-occupied housing units; not a property appraisal or candidate-site valuation.
metrics.source_label: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020-2024 ACS 5-Year Detailed Tables
metrics.availability_policy: Use only DATA-04 rows whose accepted measure status is valid.
metrics.warning_policy: Show DATA-04 status, status detail, and margin of error.

metrics.definition: Median monthly gross rent for renter-occupied housing units paying cash rent.
metrics.source_label: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020-2024 ACS 5-Year Detailed Tables
metrics.availability_policy: Use only DATA-04 rows whose accepted measure status is valid.
metrics.warning_policy: Show DATA-04 status, status detail, and margin of error.

metrics.definition: Average number of people per occupied housing unit; it does not indicate household income or customer fit.
metrics.source_label: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020-2024 ACS 5-Year Detailed Tables
metrics.availability_policy: Use only DATA-04 rows whose accepted measure status is valid.
metrics.warning_policy: Show DATA-04 status, status detail, and margin of error.

metrics.definition: Households with no vehicle available as a share of all households.
metrics.source_label: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020-2024 ACS 5-Year Detailed Tables
metrics.availability_policy: Use only DATA-04 rows whose accepted measure status is valid.
metrics.warning_policy: Show DATA-04 status, status detail, and margin of error; no routing conclusion.

metrics.definition: Workers age 16 years and over who drove alone to work as a share of workers age 16 years and over.
metrics.source_label: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020-2024 ACS 5-Year Detailed Tables
metrics.availability_policy: Use only DATA-04 rows whose accepted measure status is valid.
